memberdef.name: readAsyncImpl

briefdescription.para: Coroutine implementing the prototype async read for a single client entity type T.

detaileddescription.para: Coroutine definition of the prototype async read; see the in-class declaration.

Parses id/schema from the body (400 on malformed JSON), checks read permission via GateKeeper::canRead (permitted when no GateKeeper is registered), validates the read schema, builds SQL with getSqlReadStatement, then co_awaits executeReadQueryCoro. A non-empty result is a success, an empty result and other failures are 400; DatabaseBusy maps to 503 and other exceptions to 500.
T
Client entity type (User or Provider).
req
Request carrying the JSON body and Auth identity attributes.
cb
Response callback, consumed exactly once.
clientType
Registry key used for the controller lookup.
Clients::readAsyncImpl

briefdescription.para: REST controller for client accounts (users and providers).

detaileddescription.para: A {clientType} path segment selects a ClientController<User> or ClientController<Provider> from a variant registry. create and login are INSECURE (no token required); all other routes are SECURE and use the identity attributes inserted by Auth. Most handlers delegate to executeControllerMethod; several provide a drogon::Task coroutine path when DatabaseConfig::async is set, and read has a prototype async implementation for users and providers only. Controllers, GateKeeper, DatabaseController and the executor are shared service-locator objects.
